title: Tahoe 2024
description: Our best Tahoe trip with family and a close friend: a day of fresh snowfall, lakeside sunsets, and winter play. We made a snowman together, enjoyed colorful skies over the pier, and soaked in the quiet beauty of snow-covered trees and mountain views.

images.caption: A frozen lake and snowcapped ridge at early light, with mountains stretching into the distance.
Sampada and I paused at one of the most beautiful stops en route to Tahoe, sipping chai from home as rosy winter light painted the snowy hills.
A beautiful pink evening at Lake Tahoe, with mesmerizing landscapes and a simple, beautiful pier.
A quiet winter evening by the pier, with glowing sky and the lodge reflected in the calm lake.
A sunset view of the pier and shoreline, with pink sky reflected across the winter lake.
Base Camp Pizza in South Lake Tahoe, one of the best spots around — always worth the long vacation line for its cozy winter pizza feast.
A panoramic winter scene with snow-covered trees overlooking the lake and distant mountains.
A family portrait in falling snow, gathered around the snowman we built together.
Kids posing with a playful snow sculpture under a bright winter sky.
